integrity: All-size statements supported by an explicit combinatorial proof and singularity argument; standard-library checks are finite corroboration, not independent certification.
limitations: Exactly two occurrences per distinct symbol; labeled linear words; witnesses are unordered partitions of positions; no claim for higher multiplicities. The previously published nonnesting criterion and Catalan unrefined census are background. An unindexed refined matching formulation could subsume the result.
title: Witness multiplicities and rare-event moments for double-occurrence shuffle squares
